Title: General availability: Virtual Machine Scale Sets

Body.Content: We are excited to announce the general availability of Azure Virtual Machine Scale Sets. VM Scale Sets are a new compute service that makes it very easy to deploy a large number of identically configured virtual machines together, and to integrate them with Azure Autoscale and Azure Load Balancer. VM Scale Sets are available in all regions where virtual machines are available, and they have no additional cost.  Please give them a try today. To learn more, see the VM Scale Sets webpage.
Body.Markdown:
We are excited to announce the general availability of Azure Virtual Machine Scale Sets. VM Scale Sets are a new compute service that makes it very easy to deploy a large number of identically configured virtual machines together, and to integrate them with Azure Autoscale and Azure Load Balancer. VM Scale Sets are available in all regions where virtual machines are available, and they have no additional cost.

Please give them a try today. To learn more, see the VM Scale Sets webpage .
